cards.ex: Even when everyone disagreed with her, she stuck to her guns and ultimately proved to be right.
cards.exUz: Hatto hamma unga qarshi bo'lsa ham, u o'z so'zida turdi va oxir-oqibatda haqligini isbotladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni yoki qaroringizni qat'iy himoya qilish, boshqalarning fikriga qaramay.

cards.ex: He finally copped to lying about his qualifications on the application form.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat ariza formasida malakasi haqida yolg'on gapirganini tan oldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir noto'g'ri qilganingizni tan olish, ayniqsa, yashirishga harakat qilgan bo'lsangiz.

cards.ex: As the CEO, the buck stops here; I will take full responsibility for the company's performance.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor sifatida, yakuniy javobgarlik meniki; kompaniyaning faoliyati uchun to'liq javobgarlikni o'z zimmamga olaman.
cards.uzDef: Yakuniy javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olish, boshqalarga o'tkazmaslik.

cards.ex: She took it upon herself to organize the charity event, even though it wasn't her job.
cards.exUz: U xayriya tadbirini tashkil qilishni o'z zimmasiga oldi, garchi bu uning ishi bo'lmasa ham.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilish uchun javobgarlikni o'z xohishingiz bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Don't blame yourself; it's not your fault the project failed.
cards.exUz: O'zingizni ayblamang; loyihaning muvaffaqiyatsizligi sizning aybingiz emas.
cards.uzDef: Sizning xatoingiz yoki aybingiz bilan sodir bo'lmaganligini bildirish.

cards.ex: Many of the original plans fell by the wayside due to lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Moliyalashtirishning yetishmasligi sababli dastlabki rejalar ko'pchiligini amalga oshirishning imkoni bo'lmadi.
cards.uzDef: Unutilib ketmoq, amalga oshmay qolmoq yoki e'tibordan chetda qolmoq.

cards.ex: He tried to pass the blame for the error onto his assistant, but no one believed him.
cards.exUz: U xatolik uchun aybni yordamchisiga yuklashga harakat qildi, lekin hech kim unga ishonmadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqaga ayb yuklash, o'zingizdan soqit qilishga urinish.

cards.ex: If you want to fix the situation, you need to own the problem first.
cards.exUz: Agar vaziyatni tuzatmoqchi bo'lsangiz, avvalambor muammoni tan olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni yashirmasdan, uni hal qilish uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: The manager will be held accountable for the team's poor performance.
cards.exUz: Menejer jamoaning yomon ishlashi uchun javob berishga majbur bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Nima qilganingiz yoki qilmaganingiz uchun javob berishingiz kerakligi.

cards.ex: He threw his colleague under the bus to save his own job.
cards.exUz: U o'z ishini saqlab qolish uchun hamkasbini sotdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni himoya qilish uchun boshqani ayblash yoki xiyonat qilish.

cards.ex: She decided to shoulder the responsibility of caring for her elderly parents.
cards.exUz: U keksa ota-onasiga g'amxo'rlik qilish mas'uliyatini o'z zimmasiga olishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olish va uni hal qilishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: With Sarah at the helm, the project is sure to succeed.
cards.exUz: Sarah boshqaruvda bo'lgani uchun loyiha albatta muvaffaqiyat qozonadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqaruv yoki javobgarlik lavozimida bo'lish.

cards.ex: After a thorough investigation, he was cleared of all charges.
cards.exUz: Puxta tekshiruvdan so'ng, u barcha ayblovlardan ozod qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Aybdor emasligi isbotlanmoq, ayblovdan ozod etilmoq.

cards.ex: His words carry a lot of weight in this company, so be careful what you say.
cards.exUz: Uning so'zlari bu kompaniyada katta ahamiyatga ega, shuning uchun nima deyayotganingizga e'tibor bering.
cards.uzDef: Ta'sirga ega bo'lmoq, ahamiyatga ega bo'lmoq (mas'uliyat, ayblov).

cards.ex: The company's decision to outsource the work raised a question of ethics.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning ishni autsorsingga berish qarori axloq masalasini ko'tardi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri va noto'g'ri xatti-harakatlar haqidagi savol.

cards.ex: Eventually, the corrupt politician got his comeuppance and was sent to jail.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibat, korruptsiyaga botgan siyosatchi jazosini oldi va qamoqqa tashlandi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ishlar uchun adolatli jazo yoki oqibatni ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: She is in charge of the marketing department and all its activities.
cards.exUz: U marketing bo'limi va uning barcha faoliyati uchun javobgardir.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa yoki kimnidir boshqarish, javobgarligini o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: They opted for a no-fault divorce to avoid a lengthy and acrimonious court battle.
cards.exUz: Ular uzoq va achchiq sud jarayonidan qochish uchun aybsiz ajrashishni tanladilar.
cards.uzDef: Ajrashishning bir turi, unda hech kim aybdor deb topilmaydi.

cards.ex: I take issue with your statement that all young people are lazy.
cards.exUz: Men barcha yoshlar dangasa degan gapingizga norozilik bildiraman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga rozi bo'lmaslik yoki qarshi ekanligini bildirish.

cards.ex: He tried to cover his tracks by deleting the incriminating emails.
cards.exUz: U o'zini aybdor qiladigan elektron pochta xabarlarini o'chirib, izini yo'qotishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish qilganingizni yashirishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: If he defaults on the loan, his parents will be on the hook for the remaining amount.
cards.exUz: Agar u kreditni to'lay olmasa, uning ota-onasi qolgan summani to'lashga javobgar bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Qarz, xarajat yoki muammo uchun javobgar bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: It took her a long time to come to terms with the loss of her job.
cards.exUz: U ishini yo'qotishiga ko'nikish uchun uzoq vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz narsani qabul qilish va unga ko'nikish.

cards.ex: The CEO has blood on his hands because he ignored the safety warnings.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor xavfsizlik haqidagi ogohlantirishlarga e'tibor bermagani uchun uning qo'llari qonga botgan.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirning o'limiga bevosita yoki bilvosita sababchi bo'lish.

cards.ex: He tried to muddy the waters by spreading false rumors about his opponent.
cards.exUz: U raqibi haqida yolg'on mish-mishlar tarqatib, vaziyatni chigallashtirishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tushunishni qiyinlashtirmoq, chalkashtirib yubormoq.

cards.ex: Opening that investigation would open a can of worms that we're not ready to deal with.
cards.exUz: Ushbu tergovni ochish biz hal qilishga tayyor bo'lmagan muammolar to'plamini ochadi.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab va noxush oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan muammoli vaziyat.

cards.ex: If you break the law, you have to face the consequences.
cards.exUz: Agar qonunni buzilsa, oqibatlariga duch kelish kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatti-harakatlaringizning natijalarini qabul qilish va ularga duch kelish.

cards.ex: The spokesperson had to take the flak for the company's controversial decision.
cards.exUz: Matbuot kotibi kompaniyaning bahsli qarori uchun tanqidni qabul qilishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tanqid, norozilik yoki ayblovlarni qabul qilish.

cards.ex: It's rare for politicians to escape criticism these days.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilarning hozirgi kunda tanqidga uchramasligi kamdan kam uchraydi.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki noto'g'ri ish qilgan bo'lsangiz ham, tanqidga uchramaslik.

cards.ex: He was under pressure to meet the deadline, so he worked late every night.
cards.exUz: U muddatga yetish uchun bosim ostida edi, shuning uchun u har kecha kechgacha ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilish uchun majburiy his qilish, bosim sezish.

cards.ex: The insurance company claimed the damage was caused by an act of God and refused to pay.
cards.exUz: Sug'urta kompaniyasi zarar tabiiy ofat sabab bo'lgan deb da'vo qildi va to'lashdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan va oldini olishning iloji bo'lmagan tabiiy hodisa (masalan, zilzila, to'fon).
